JUDGMENT:
JUDGMENT
                                  O R D E R
                             CIVIL APPEAL NO.8079 OF 2001
        This appeal has been filed against an order passed by the High Court 
of Madhya Pradesh, Indore Bench in civil revision case when admittedly  
the  suit was pending. It has been brought to our notice by the learned 
counsel for the appellant that the suit itself has now been disposed of. In 
this view of the matter, this appeal has now become infructuous and is 
disposed of as such. There will be no order as to costs.
        The interim order, if any, shall stand vacated.
